findingDetails.title: Generated leaf registries for system-skill-advisor still cite four deleted leaf docs
findingDetails.evidence: leaf-manifest.json:46-47 and :96-97 still list feature-catalog/scorer-fusion/suggested-order-eval.md, feature-catalog/scorer-fusion/tie-break-eval.md and their manual-testing-playbook copies; leaf-aliases.json:209-215 and :459-465 project the same dead diskPaths. All four files are absent from the working tree. leaf-manifest.config.json documents both as generated ('regenerate both together via ci-skill-root-metadata.cjs --fix'), and ci-skill-root-metadata.cjs regenerates the manifest from a disk walk, byte-compares, and raises STALE_GENERATED_FILE (:227-236) with fail status (:586); routing-registry-drift.yml:187-197 runs that checker for every skill root on any push touching the advisor runtime, which the deletion commits did. The deletion commits touched no leaf-manifest/leaf-aliases file (git show --name-only over the eight named SHAs, grep for leaf-manifest|leaf-aliases|graph-metadata returns empty). .opencode/skills/system-skill-advisor/leaf-manifest.json is the same inode (604040828) as the .skilled path, so both views are stale.
findingDetails.scopeProof: Repo-wide git grep for the four deleted doc basenames and all nine deleted scorer basenames, excluding specs/ and changelog/, returns no live code, test, hook, command, package.json or CI reference outside these two generated registries; mirrors (.opencode, .hermes, .claude, .codex, .cursor, .pi, .devin) hold no deleted scorer file (find over all nine names returns empty).
findingDetails.claim: The kill-list deletion did not regenerate system-skill-advisor's derived leaf registries, leaving live generated artifacts that reference four deleted leaf docs; the CI metadata gate will report them stale.
findingDetails.counterevidenceSought: Checked (a) whether any deletion commit regenerated leaf registries (none did); (b) whether .opencode carried an independently generated, possibly fresh copy (it is a hardlink to the same inode); (c) whether mirrors still ship the deleted scripts (none found); (d) whether the metadata step is warn-only (only the compiled-route admission step is marked --warn-only; the metadata class contract is a gate).
findingDetails.alternativeExplanation: ci-skill-root-metadata.cjs may skip standalone roots that carry no mode-registry.json, in which case the stale registry is dead data rather than a CI failure.
findingDetails.downgradeTrigger: Show that ci-skill-root-metadata.cjs does not evaluate system-skill-advisor, or that the workflow path filter excludes these commits: downgrade to P2 (stale generated data with no gate impact).
findingDetails.recommendation: Regenerate the pair per leaf-manifest.config.json with `node .skilled/skills/sk-doc/sk-create-skill/scripts/ci-skill-root-metadata.cjs --fix --skill system-skill-advisor`, then rerun the Routing Registry Drift Guard.
